segments.text: Second question, what is two wattmeter method?

segments.text: We are going to connect two wattmeter at any two lines and the total power we are providing

segments.text: So, using two wattmeter method, it is very easy to calculate power factor.

segments.text: Anyway, you will be getting the reading of W1 and W2.

segments.text: First, what you will do is, you will be calculating the tan phi.
segments.zh: 首先你要做的是计算 tan φ。

segments.text: Tan phi can be calculated using the formula root three into W2 minus W1 by W1 plus W2.
segments.zh: tan φ 可以用公式计算：根号三乘以 W2 减 W1，除以 W1 加 W2。

segments.text: From this, you need to calculate phi.
segments.zh: 由此你需要算出 φ。

segments.text: Phi is equal to tan inverse of root three into W2 minus W1 by W1 plus W2.
segments.zh: φ 等于根号三乘以 W2 减 W1 除以 W1 加 W2 的反正切。

segments.text: From this, you can directly take a cos phi.
segments.zh: 由此可以直接得到 cos φ。

segments.text: That is nothing but cosine of tan inverse root three into W2 minus W1 divided by
segments.zh: 也就是根号三乘以 W2 减 W1 除以
